body: Southwest Airlines Flight 3396 lost power in its No. 2 engine shortly after taking off from John Wayne Airport-Orange County (SNA) on Friday, November 6, 2026, prompting the crew to declare an emergency and squawk 7700. The Boeing 737-700, registration N281WN, was operating a scheduled service from Santa Ana to Norman Y. Mineta San Jose International Airport (SJC) with 97 people on board, and diverted to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), where it landed safely.

Flight data shows the aircraft pushed back at 11:49, 14 minutes behind its scheduled 11:35 departure, and turned southwest after the engine issue, circling over the South Bay. The jet never climbed above 5,000 feet (1,524 metres), and after 18 minutes above the Pacific Ocean it was cleared to land, touching down on Runway 25L at LAX after a total flight time of 38 minutes. The Federal Aviation Administration said: "Southwest Airlines Flight 3396 landed safely at Los Angeles International Airport around 12:25 p.m. local time after the crew reported an engine issue."

Emergency services met the aircraft on arrival and passengers disembarked with no reports of injury; affected travellers were reaccommodated onto a replacement flight to San Jose scheduled to depart at 1:13 p.m. Southwest said its pilots received an engine-related maintenance indication, followed established procedures and landed uneventfully. N281WN, delivered in June 2007 as the 500th Boeing 737 for Southwest, is configured with 143 seats in an all-economy layout and powered by two CFMI CFM56-7B24 engines; Southwest operates around 270 Boeing 737-700s, making it the world's largest operator of the type.
en.summary: Southwest Airlines Flight 3396 lost power in its No. 2 engine shortly after departing John Wayne Airport on November 6, declared an emergency and diverted to Los Angeles International Airport, landing safely with 97 people on board and no injuries reported.
en.title: Southwest Airlines Boeing 737 loses No. 2 engine after takeoff, declares emergency and diverts to Los Angeles

body: 西南航空3396號班機11月6日自加州約翰韋恩機場起飛後不久失去二號發動機動力，機組宣布緊急狀態並發出7700緊急代碼，隨即轉降洛杉磯國際機場。該班機原定由聖安娜飛往聖荷西，機型為19年機齡的波音737-700，機身編號N281WN，機上共有97人。
根據飛航數據，該機原定11時35分出發，實際於11時49分離場，起飛後不久轉向西南，飛往洛杉磯南灣上空盤旋，飛行高度未曾超過5,000呎。機組在太平洋上空盤旋18分鐘後獲准進場，於洛杉磯國際機場25L跑道安全降落，全程共38分鐘。美國聯邦航空總署表示，該班機在機組通報發動機問題後，已於當地時間12時25分左右安全降落洛杉磯國際機場。

飛機降落後由緊急服務單位在場接應，旅客陸續下機，無人受傷，西南航空已安排旅客改搭原定13時13分出發的替代航班前往聖荷西。西南航空表示，機組在飛行途中收到發動機相關維護指示後依既定程序處置並平安降落。涉事飛機N281WN於2007年6月交付，是西南航空接收的第500架737，採全經濟艙布局，可載143名旅客，配備兩具CFM56-7B24發動機；西南航空現役約270架737-700，是全球最大的737-700營運商。
zh.summary: 西南航空3396號班機11月6日自約翰韋恩機場起飛後不久二號發動機失去動力，機組宣布緊急狀態，機上97人搭乘的737-700安全轉降洛杉磯國際機場，無人受傷。
